name: Links open the app's own window
author: wizard
description: WizardOS Android app: a link to a Wizard app opens that app in its own Android window, the same one its home-screen icon opens, whether or not you pinned it. This covers Open on a notification, links in chats and links from one app to another (a Messenger message linking to Health opens Health's window). Back at the app's start returns to where you tapped the link. Links to Wizard's own home and chats stay in the main window.
